gists.title: Welcome to the Lakehouse
gists.content: The Mind Palace Lakehouse is a multi-level interactive environment. Explore rooms, interact with furniture, and discover the filing system. Each room has unique objects and atmosphere.

gists.title: Controls Guide
gists.content:
WASD / Arrow Keys — Move
Mouse — Look around
E — Interact with objects
F — Push movable objects
I — Open inventory
M — Toggle minimap
G — Open this gist wall
ESC — Close panels

gists.title: Room Directory
gists.content:
Ground Floor: Living Room, Kitchen, Dining Room, Hallway, Mudroom, Bathroom, Porch, Deck
Upper Floor: Master Bedroom, Guest Bedrooms, Office, Library, Bathroom
Basement: Main Area, Laundry
Attic: Storage

gists.title: Filing System
gists.content: File cabinets are located throughout the lakehouse. Approach a cabinet and press E to open it. Each cabinet contains searchable documents. Use the filing system to store and retrieve notes.

gists.title: About Mind Palace
gists.content: Mind Palace is a spatial memory system that maps your projects, notes, and ideas to a virtual environment. The Lakehouse is the first of many environments. Explore, interact, and make it your own.
